# Manuel Bomheker

> Strategic communication for universities, research and innovation.

Official English website: https://manuelbomheker.com/en/

Manuel Bomheker works with universities, research institutions, innovation initiatives and university incubators that need to move from isolated communication efforts to shared standards, clear messaging and sustained institutional relationships.

## Main services

- Strategic consulting in institutional communications.
- Communications assessment, positioning and message architecture.
- Strategy for engagement, knowledge transfer, innovation and funding.
- Communications governance, workflows, decision standards and channels.
- Tactical advisory for funding calls, identity systems, narratives, documents and presentations.
- Training and mentoring for researchers, communications teams and university incubators.
- Academic personal branding, science communication, pitch and idea validation.

## Signals addressed

- There is value, but it is difficult to communicate clearly.
- Channels exist, but they do not operate as a system.
- Key relationships rely too heavily on individual efforts.

## Approach

The work structures messages, standards and tools so communication can make value clear, coordinate channels and sustain strategic relationships with partners, communities, companies, public agencies and funders.

## Experience

Experience working with complex organizations connected to universities, research and innovation, including Universidad Nacional de Córdoba, Facultad de Ciencias Exactas, Físicas y Naturales, DASPU, Consejo Federal de Decanos de Ingeniería, Asociación de Universidades Grupo Montevideo, Consejo Interuniversitario Nacional, Universidad Nacional de Cuyo, university incubators, Universidad Nacional del Nordeste, CONICET and scientific institutes.

## Public resources

- YouTube: interviews and classes on strategic communication and brand management for academic institutions.
- Medium: articles, resources and notes on communication management, institutional assessment and academic organizations.
- LinkedIn: lessons, cases, reflections and work experiences in strategic communication, brand and institutional management.
